d.tr: Will I get your personal number?
d.ctx: The user asks the expert for her personal number. The expert refuses.
d.j: The user is asking for the expert's personal phone number.

d.seg: क्योंकि मैं पर्सनल नंबर नहीं देती।
d.tr: Because I don't give out my personal number.
d.ctx: The expert explains why she won't give her number. The user continues to ask.
d.j: The expert is refusing to share her personal number.

d.ctx: The user insists on getting the expert's personal number. The expert refuses again.
d.j: The user is asking for the expert's personal phone number.

d.seg: नो। इसी पे बात करती हूँ।
d.ctx: The expert refuses to share her number and says she only talks on the app. The user continues to ask.
d.j: The expert is refusing to share her personal number and stating she only uses the app.

d.seg: इसी पे ही बात करती हूँ मैं, पर्सनल नंबर नहीं देती।
d.tr: I only talk on this, I don't give out my personal number.
d.ctx: The expert reiterates that she only talks on the app. The user continues to ask.
d.j: The expert is refusing to share her personal number and stating she only uses the app.
